item.title: Madwackd Productions Releases the Official Trailer for THE EARTH MOVIE and Opens $2.99 Presale Tickets
item.dc:creator: Madwackd Productions
item.description: The official trailer for THE EARTH MOVIE, a family-friendly AI-made satire from Denver's Madwackd Productions, is out now. Presale tickets are $2.99, refundable before release, and 1.5% of ticket sales goes to carbon removal.
